items.title: PG&E downgraded by Wells Fargo, BMO as California wildfire reform falls short
items.summary: Investing.com -- PG&E Corp shares could face further pressure after Wells Fargo and BMO Capital Markets downgraded the utility following California lawmakers' failure to deliver meaningful reforms to the state's wildfire liability framework, leaving investors exposed to potentially open-ended costs from future fires.
